description: Health Care Claim: Institutional (837I; 005010X223A1 and 005010X223 resolve here) — submitted claims projected out of the object graph (DESIGN §8.5).

dimensions.name: receiverName
dimensions.description: 1000B NM1*40 — who the batch was sent to

dimensions.name: billingProviderName
dimensions.description: 2010AA NM1*85; only when every 2000A in the transaction names the same provider

dimensions.name: billingProviderNpi
dimensions.description: 2010AA NM109 (an NPI when NM108=XX); unambiguous-or-absent like the name

dimensions.name: payerName
dimensions.description: 2010BB NM1*PR; only when every subscriber in the transaction names the same payer — the per-claim payer is a column

dimensions.name: payerId
dimensions.description: 2010BB NM109 payer identifier; unambiguous-or-absent like the name

entities.name: Claim
entities.description: One submitted institutional claim. Grain is loop2300 — the CLM loop.

columns.name: claimId
columns.description: CLM01 — the patient control number the 835 echoes back in CLP01

columns.name: chargedAmount
columns.description: CLM02 total claim charge amount

columns.name: facilityTypeCode
columns.description: CLM05-1 (C023) — facility type code (first two digits of the type of bill)

columns.name: facilityCodeQualifier
columns.description: CLM05-2 — A: uniform billing claim form bill type

columns.name: claimFrequencyCode
columns.description: CLM05-3 — 1 original, 7 replacement, 8 void

columns.name: statementFromDate
columns.description: DTP*434 (RD8) — statement covers period, start

columns.name: statementToDate
columns.description: DTP*434 (RD8) — statement covers period, end

columns.name: admissionDate
columns.description: DTP*435 — admission date (inpatient claims)

columns.name: admissionTypeCode
columns.description: CL101 — priority (type) of admission

columns.name: patientStatusCode
columns.description: CL103 — discharge status

columns.name: principalDiagnosisQualifier
columns.description: First HI, HI01-1 — ABK (ICD-10) or BK (ICD-9)

columns.name: principalDiagnosisCode
columns.description: First HI, HI01-2 — the principal diagnosis

columns.name: attendingProviderLastName
columns.description: 2310A NM1*71 — attending provider

columns.name: subscriberLastName
columns.description: 2010BA NM1*IL of the enclosing subscriber (the ^ step reads the ancestor 2000B)

columns.name: subscriberMemberId
columns.description: 2010BA NM109 — the member id

columns.name: payerResponsibilityCode
columns.description: SBR01 — P primary, S secondary, T tertiary

columns.name: claimPayerName
columns.description: 2010BB NM1*PR of THIS claim's subscriber — exact per claim, where the payerName dimension is only set for single-payer transactions

entities.name: ServiceLine
entities.description: One submitted institutional service line. Grain is loop2400 — the LX/SV2 loop.

columns.name: claimId
columns.description: CLM01 of the enclosing claim — the join key back to /institutional-claims

columns.name: lineNumber
columns.description: LX01 — line number, unique within its claim

columns.name: revenueCode
columns.description: SV201 — revenue code (NUBC)

columns.name: procedureQualifier
columns.description: SV202-1 (C003): HC, ER, HP, IV, WK

columns.name: chargedAmount
columns.description: SV203 line item charge amount

columns.name: unitBasis
columns.description: SV204 — UN units, DA days

columns.name: serviceDate
columns.description: DTP*472 — date of service (start, when RD8)

columns.name: serviceDateTo
columns.description: DTP*472 — end of the service range (same as serviceDate for D8)

entities.name: Payer
entities.description: One row per distinct payer, whichever guide named it (835 N1*PR, 837 NM1*PR). Identity: payerId when stated; a name-only occurrence joins the one identified payer of the same name, else stands alone (DESIGN §8.5).

columns.name: payerKey
columns.description: id:<payerId>, or name:<NORMALIZED NAME> for a payer never seen with an identifier

columns.name: payerName
columns.description: The name most of this payer's transactions carry

columns.name: payerId
columns.description: 835 N104 / 837 NM109 (2010BB); null when the payer was only ever named

columns.name: transactionCount
columns.description: Transaction sets in the buffer that name this payer

columns.name: firstSeen
columns.description: Receipt time of the earliest of them

columns.name: lastSeen
columns.description: Receipt time of the latest of them

columns.name: transactionTypes
columns.description: Comma-separated transaction types it appears in, e.g. 835,837I,837P
